correctness.rationale: For every four marked leaves in a subcubic rank-decomposition, the central 2+2 edge has binary cross-rank at most one. Consequently at most two cross-neighborhood signatures occur in each direction and the four-by-four table admits at most two full rows union two full columns, hence twelve. The thirteen-vertex concrete distance-hereditary example produces twelve distinct traces; three parameter-vertex traces plus nine private outsider traces yield every count 3..12 by induced deletions. Four isolates and the four-vertex star give counts 1 and 2. The eight-vertex connected distance-hereditary graph realizes all 8 traces on a triple; 8 vertices are necessarily required. Both examples have independently checked pendant/twin reduction certificates in checker.py.
